title: Espressif ESP-WROOM-02D-N4 4MB WiFi Module | ESP8266EX | 2.4GHz Wireless MCU Module
description:
The Espressif ESP-WROOM-02D-N4 is a compact, high-performance Wi-Fi module based on the ESP8266EX SoC, designed for IoT, smart home, industrial automation, wireless communication, and embedded applications. It features an integrated Tensilica L106 32-bit RISC processor with a maximum clock speed of 160 MHz, delivering reliable performance while maintaining low power consumption.

The module comes with 4MB Flash memory and supports IEEE 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi operating in the 2.4 GHz frequency band. With multiple peripheral interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, I2S, PWM, GPIO, and IR, the ESP-WROOM-02D-N4 offers excellent flexibility for a wide range of embedded designs.

Designed for commercial and industrial applications, the module complies with major international certifications including FCC, CE, IC, TELEC, SRRC, and RoHS, ensuring dependable performance and regulatory compliance.
features: CPU Clock Speed up to 160 MHz
Supports Station (STA), SoftAP (AP), and AP+STA modes
UART, SPI, I2C, I2S, PWM, GPIO, and IR interfaces
Compact SMD module with onboard PCB antenna
Certified with FCC, CE, IC, TELEC, SRRC, RoHS, and REACH
Compatible with ESP8266 SDK, Arduino IDE, PlatformIO, NodeMCU, and MicroPython

title: Espressif ESP32-WROOM-32E-N4 WiFi Bluetooth SoC Module | 4MB Flash | Onboard PCB Antenna | Dual-Core MCU
description:
The Espressif ESP32-WROOM-32E-N4 is an original WiFi and Bluetooth System-on-Chip (SoC) module designed for IoT, embedded systems, industrial automation, smart home, wireless communication, and AIoT applications. Powered by the ESP32-D0WD-V3 dual-core Xtensa® 32-bit LX6 processor, this module delivers excellent processing performance while maintaining low power consumption.

The module integrates 4MB Flash memory, 2.4GHz Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n), Bluetooth Classic, and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). Its onboard PCB antenna provides reliable wireless communication without the need for an external antenna, making it ideal for compact and cost-effective designs.

With multiple communication interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, I2S, PWM, ADC, DAC, SDIO, CAN, GPIO, and JTAG, the ESP32-WROOM-32E-N4 is suitable for a wide range of commercial and industrial embedded applications.

title: 2.4-inch SPI Interface 240x320 TFT Display Module
description:
The 2.4 Inch SPI TFT LCD Display Module is a compact, full-color display designed for embedded systems and microcontroller projects. It features a 240 × 320 pixel resolution and uses either the ILI9341 or ST7789 display controller, depending on stock availability. The module communicates through the SPI interface, requiring only a few GPIO pins, making it ideal for Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi, and other development boards.

The display provides vibrant colors, a wide viewing angle, and includes support for MicroSD cards through the hardware SPI interface, making it suitable for graphical user interfaces, data visualization, and multimedia applications.
features: Hardware SPI support for MicroSD card
Requires only 5 control pins in SPI mode
Easy interface with Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi, and AVR boards
Compact PCB design for embedded applications

title: 2.8 inch SPI Touch Screen Module TFT Interface 240*320
description:
The 2.8 Inch SPI TFT LCD Touch Display Module is a high-quality color display featuring a 240 × 320 pixel resolution with a built-in resistive touch panel. It uses the ST7789 display driver and supports both SPI and 8-bit parallel interfaces, making it compatible with a wide range of microcontrollers including Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi, and AVR.

The display offers bright colors, a wide viewing angle, and smooth graphics with 262K color depth. It also includes an onboard MicroSD card slot, allowing images and graphics to be stored and displayed directly from a memory card. The module operates from 3.3V to 5V, making it easy to integrate into embedded systems, industrial projects, and DIY electronics.
features: Easy connection with Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi
Suitable for embedded and industrial applications

title: Hi-Link HLK-5M12 12V 5W AC-DC Switch Power Supply Module
description:
The Hi-Link HLK-5M12 is a compact and reliable AC to DC power supply module that converts 90V–264V AC mains voltage into a stable 12V DC output with a maximum power of 5W. Its small size and high efficiency make it ideal for PCB-mounted electronic projects, smart home devices, industrial control systems, IoT products, and automation applications.

The module features built-in protection against overload and short circuits, ensuring safe and reliable operation. It is designed to meet UL, CE, EMC, and safety standards, making it suitable for both hobby and professional electronic designs.
features: Compact and lightweight PCB mount design
High efficiency with low power consumption
Low ripple and low noise output
Built-in overload and short circuit protection
Meets UL, CE, EMC, and Safety standards
Easy to integrate into electronic circuits

title: 40 Pin DIP IC Socket Base Adaptor
description:
40 Pin IC Socket base adaptor is a 40 pin IC holder, which can be soldered directly onto the PCB. The IC can be removed from this socket when required. The IC is placed on the socket at the time of use. This base acts as a removable IC holder.

The socket is used when the IC is temperature sensitive and the heat from the soldering iron can damage the IC. This socket is used when working with a microcontroller IC and can be removed for programming.
